value.zh-Hant: 秘魯法學家與政治人物，曾任眾議員、多次出任內政部長；1918年12月起兼任內政部長與部長會議主席，至1919年4月辭職。1931年底至1932年1月再任部長會議主席，後任最高法院法官。
value.en: Peruvian jurist and politician, a deputy and several-time Minister of Government. He served as Minister of Government and President of the Council of Ministers from December 1918 until April 1919, again from December 1931 to January 1932, and later became a Supreme Court judge.
